name: PortfolioBubbleChart
tagline: Portfolio Bubble Chart turns a list of records into a quadrant bubble chart.
description: Portfolio Bubble Chart turns a list of records into a quadrant bubble chart. Each record is a bubble: its position shows two measures (for example business value across and delivery risk up), its size shows a third (for example budget) and its colour shows a category (for example the programme).
features: Plot records by two measures (e.g. value vs risk, spend vs supply risk) with bubble size and category colour
Sortable table / phone card list, KPIs
Keyboard and touch navigation and a phone layout
